title: ccusage-web config
description: Per PRD v3 §1 R3.9–R3.12. Configures cost-mode, week-start, sort order, budget thresholds, and timezone. Loader priority chain: CLI > env CCUSAGE_CONFIG > .ccusage/ccusage.json (project, cwd walk-up) > ~/.config/claude/ccusage.json (user) > ~/.claude/ccusage.json (legacy) > defaults. Higher-priority files override lower for each key.

$schema.description: IDE-autocomplete pointer. Loader recognizes + ignores per R3.12.AC2.

tokenLimit.description: Pre-block token limit (R3.7). Drives the --token-limit flag passthrough to ccusage shellout.

monthlyCapUSD.description: Monthly USD cap (R3.7). When set, the X1 banner fires once projected month-end > cap.

perBlockTokenLimit.description: Per-block token cap (R3.7). Drives the amber X1 chip in BlockHistoryStrip.

startOfWeek.description: Which day starts the week (R3.2). Defaults to monday.

order.description: Default sort order for tables (R3.3). Defaults to desc.

costMode.description: Cost-mode override for the ccusage shellout (R3 §D). Defaults to calculate.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for date-bucket keys + display rollover. Defaults to the host's resolved timezone.

sessionLengthHours.description: R4.5 B16: billing-block window in hours (default 5 per iter0-R1 §5). Drives native buildBlocks AND the ccusage --session-length flag.

recentBlocks.description: R4.5 B15: how many trailing blocks the BlocksPanel Recent tab surfaces (default 8).
